scheme_name: ICAR Senior Research Fellowship For Post-Graduate Studies In Agricultural Sciences
other_conditions: Must have completed a Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent OGPA from a recognized university (relaxed by 5% for SC/ST/PH candidates)
Must appear for the All India Competitive Entrance Examination and secure admission to a Ph.D. programme in one of the listed Agricultural Universities
Ph.D. admission must be in an Agricultural University different from the one where the Master’s degree was obtained
Upper age limit is 30 years (relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST/PH, by 3 years for OBC, and up to 45 years for in‑service candidates)
Candidates in their final semester are eligible if they obtain the degree before the examination date and provide the degree certificate
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹12,000 for Veterinary Sciences (₹8,640 for other disciplines) plus an annual contingency grant of ₹6,000.
